notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
